status: written before any WP7 fit with a new target was run or any WP7 metric was computed
concepts: 18 EMBER paper concepts (data/concept_sentences.json); eta/gamma grid: the 15 outside {Harry Potter, Ancient Rome, Valentine's Day}
fit: experiments/varwidth/core.fit_varwidth, VWConfig(method='fixed', refit=False) = RS-1% (tag fixed_refit-False); GS (method='rn') as a secondary if time allows

conditions.disjoint: page sentences minus near-duplicates of S_C or S_N (exact / shared word 8-gram / word-set Jaccard >= 0.5)
conditions.related: first 4 qualifying pages from the main page's Main/Further/See also hatnotes; near-duplicates of S_C/S_N removed; pooled; subsampled (seed 0) to the main page's sentence count if larger
conditions.leakfree: page minus every V* token type
conditions.wrong: page target of a fixed unrelated concept (common.WRONG)
conditions.pagesub: size control for disjoint: random page sentences (seed 0), as many as the disjoint set

concept_feature: f* = argmax over features of (lexicon hits among top-20 source words, rho); lexicon = concept_words_v1
strict_label: concept-only AND (lexicon word OR (n_SC >= 2 AND log(p_SC / p_Wiki) >= log 10)); p_Wiki = (n_W + 1) / (N_W + V) over 40k articles of the cached wikimedia/wikipedia shard 00040
secondary_metrics: held-out-token auc_S / purity_strict for tokens not in each target
unit_and_tests: concept = unit (mean over seeds); each target vs raw: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank (two-sided), bootstrap 95% CI of the mean difference (10,000 resamples over concepts, seed 0); Holm over the primary family (2 metrics x 6 targets); retention = mean(target - raw) / mean(page - raw) with bootstrap CI
interpretation_rule: gain is concept-specific and not circular if disjoint and/or related keep most (>= 50%) of the page gain over raw on the primary metrics while wrong does not improve over raw; if only page works, report that plainly
eta_gamma_rule: per concept rank the 9 configs on rho_rank (low better), purity_strict, purity_C, auc_S, lex_top20 (ties averaged); mean rank over metrics x concepts; report the default's rank and its gap to the best config per metric with bootstrap CI
